results.title: EU to resume preparations for opening negotiating clusters for Ukraine and Moldova on 1 September – sources
results.description: After the summer recess, the Working Party on Enlargement and Countries Negotiating Accession to the EU (COELA) will consider approving the screening results for negotiating clusters 2 and 3 for Ukraine and Moldova on 1 September.
